taskDescription: Arrange these steps of collagen biosynthesis in the correct order, from ribosome to mature fibril.

sequenceImages.imageDescription: Signal peptide directs the ribosome to the RER; the alpha chain enters the ER lumen
Hydroxylation of proline and lysine, then three chains form the triple helix (procollagen) in the ER
Procollagen passes through the Golgi and is secreted by exocytosis
Propeptides are removed by proteinases; tropocollagen molecules align in a staggered array
Lysyl oxidase (copper-dependent) cross-links the fibril into a banded mature collagen fibre

l10n.score: You got @score of @total points. Collagen biosynthesis proceeds through five stages in order: signal peptide–driven entry into the RER, hydroxylation and triple-helix assembly in the ER lumen (requiring vitamin C and Fe²⁺), Golgi processing and secretion, extracellular propeptide cleavage and staggered alignment, and finally copper-dependent cross-linking by lysyl oxidase.
